page.label: Settings / Diagnostics
page.title: Settings
page.description: Connection tools, application preferences and diagnostics.

descriptions.autoReconnect: VR Control Center reconnects to known device addresses on startup and after connection loss.
descriptions.launchAtStartup: Starts VR Control Center when the user signs in to Windows or macOS.
descriptions.launchAtStartupUnavailable: Startup integration is prepared but not implemented yet.
descriptions.closeBehavior: Streams keep running when minimized to the tray. Use the OnePlace icon to reopen the app.
descriptions.runtimePollingInterval: Connection and foreground app check interval. Battery updates at most every 30 seconds. In the tray: app every minute, battery every two minutes. Reopening the window refreshes data immediately.
descriptions.customPath: Choose the executable on your computer.
descriptions.verboseLogging: Record connection and streaming details for troubleshooting.
descriptions.toolSource: Automatically uses bundled Windows tools or system PATH. A custom executable can also be selected.

logging.clearConfirm: Clear old log files? The active log file will be kept.

danger.resetDescription: Removes saved headsets, team games, profiles and settings. Active streams will stop. Game files and shortcuts stay on the PC.
danger.resetConfirm: Reset configuration? Devices, team games, profiles and settings will be removed from the application.
